Clip Detail View.notes: Rendered only when a clip is selected (created MIDI clip on Track 1 Slot 1 via MCP, selected via UIA click). With no clip selected, the group renders 'No clip selected.' as a single Text child.

Group Track Mixer.notes: Group track mixer (SessionView.GroupTrack[N].Mixer) vs normal track: NO Input Type/Channel, Monitoring, or Arm controls (audio bus); HAS Clip Stop + Send sliders. Children nest under SessionView.GroupTrack[N].Track[M].*. Survey-prep action: group track produced by selecting two tracks and pressing Ctrl+G (one-off UIA script; no MCP grouping tool), on the unsaved project — in scope per AGENTS.md 0/5.4.

Group Track Child Mixer.notes: Child track inside a group nests as SessionView.GroupTrack[N].Track[M].Mixer — same shape as a normal track's mixer strip (Input/Monitoring/Arm present). Survey-prep action: group track produced by selecting two tracks and pressing Ctrl+G (one-off UIA script; no MCP grouping tool), on the unsaved project — in scope per AGENTS.md 0/5.4.

Device Detail Panel (TrackView).notes: Device Detail / Device Chain panel wrapper. Devices render as TrackView.Device[N] groups; per-device controls cataloged in their own contexts (Phases A-D). Utility device shown here: StereoWidth carries TrackView.Device[0].StereoWidth; most other controls (Phase/Mono/Bass Mono/Gain/Balance/Mute/DC) carry empty automation_ids.
